meaning.en: to suddenly explode with anger and start shouting
meaning.tr: bir anda öfkeyle patlamak, bağırıp çağırmaya başlamak
meaning.de: plötzlich vor Wut explodieren und losschreien

equivalent.de: ausrasten, explodieren, an die Decke gehen

usage.en: Intransitive: blow up (at sb) (over/about sth). The passive "be blown up" has no emotional meaning: it means to be destroyed by a bomb, or (of a photo) to be enlarged.
usage.tr: Geçişsiz: blow up (at sb) (over/about sth). Edilgen "be blown up" duygu anlamı taşımaz: bombayla havaya uçurulmak ya da fotoğrafın büyütülmesi demektir.

collocations.en: blow up at someone · blow up over nothing · totally blow up
collocations.tr: blow up at someone · blow up over nothing · totally blow up

sentences.en: I just asked where he'd been and he totally [blew up] at me.
sentences.tr: Sadece nerede olduğunu sordum, bana fena patladı.
sentences.de: Ich habe nur gefragt, wo er war, und er ist total ausgerastet.

sentences.en: My mom's going to [blow up] when she sees the phone bill.
sentences.tr: Annem telefon faturasını görünce küplere binecek.
sentences.de: Meine Mutter geht an die Decke, wenn sie die Handyrechnung sieht.

meaning.en: to fail to control your anger
meaning.de: seine Wut nicht mehr beherrschen können

equivalent.tr: tepesi atmak, öfkesine yenilmek, kendini kaybetmek
equivalent.de: die Beherrschung verlieren, die Fassung verlieren

usage.en: lose your temper (with sb) (over sth). Opposite: keep your temper. For personality: have a short/bad temper.
usage.tr: lose your temper (with sb) (over sth). Karşıtı: keep your temper. Kişilik için: have a short/bad temper (çabuk parlayan biri olmak).

collocations.en: lose your temper with sb · a short temper · temper tantrum (a fit of rage, usually of children)
collocations.tr: lose your temper with sb · a short temper · temper tantrum (öfke nöbeti, çocuklar için)

sentences.en: I'm sorry I [lost my temper] with you earlier — it wasn't about you.
sentences.tr: Demin sana sinirlendiğim için özür dilerim, seninle ilgisi yoktu.
sentences.de: Tut mir leid, dass ich vorhin die Beherrschung verloren habe – es lag nicht an dir.

sentences.en: She almost never [loses her temper], so when she does, everybody goes quiet.
sentences.tr: Neredeyse hiç sinirlenmez, o yüzden sinirlendiğinde herkes susar.
sentences.de: Sie verliert fast nie die Beherrschung; wenn doch, werden alle still.

meaning.en: to be really angry or annoyed

equivalent.tr: sinirden kudurmak, fena bozulmak, gıcık olmak (kaba ton)

register.en: vulgar (very common among close friends; not used in formal settings)
register.tr: kaba (yakın arkadaş arasında çok yaygın; resmî ortamda kullanılmaz)

variety.en: AmE + BrE — careful: in AmE bare "pissed" = angry, in BrE bare "pissed" = drunk
variety.tr: AmE + BrE — dikkat: AmE'de yalnız "pissed" = kızgın, BrE'de yalnız "pissed" = sarhoş

usage.en: be/get pissed off (at/with sb) (about sth) → state. piss sb off → the cause is the subject: "It pisses me off."
usage.tr: be/get pissed off (at/with sb) (about sth) → durum. piss sb off → sebep olan özne: "It pisses me off."

collocations.en: pissed off at (AmE) / with (BrE) sb · really/so pissed off
collocations.tr: pissed off at (AmE) / with (BrE) sb · really/so pissed off

sentences.en: I'm so [pissed off] at Jake — he bailed on me again.
sentences.tr: Jake'e çok kızgınım, yine beni ekti.
sentences.de: Ich bin so sauer auf Jake – er hat mich schon wieder versetzt.

sentences.en: It really [pisses me off] when people talk over me in meetings.
sentences.tr: Toplantılarda insanların sözümü kesmesi beni acayip sinir ediyor.
sentences.de: Es kotzt mich echt an, wenn Leute mir in Meetings ins Wort fallen.

meaning.en: to have had too much of something that has been going on for a long time
meaning.tr: uzun süredir süren bir şeyden bıkmış, tahammülü kalmamış olmak
meaning.de: von etwas, das schon lange andauert, genug haben

equivalent.tr: bıkmak, gına gelmek, burasına kadar gelmek
equivalent.de: die Nase voll haben, es satthaben

literal.en: to have been fed until completely full

usage.en: be fed up with + noun/V-ing → current state. get fed up with → the process of reaching that point. Spoken BrE also has "fed up of"; "with" is the standard form.
usage.tr: be fed up with + isim/V-ing → mevcut durum. get fed up with → bıkma noktasına gelme süreci. BrE konuşma dilinde "fed up of" da duyulur, standart olan "with".

collocations.en: fed up with waiting · totally/really fed up · I'm fed up. (on its own: I'm miserable / I've had enough)
collocations.tr: fed up with waiting · totally/really fed up · I'm fed up. (tek başına: canım sıkkın, bıktım)

sentences.en: I'm [fed up with] doing all the work in this group project.
sentences.tr: Bu grup projesinde bütün işi benim yapmamdan bıktım.
sentences.de: Ich habe es satt, in diesem Gruppenprojekt die ganze Arbeit zu machen.

sentences.en: She [got fed up with] his excuses and just stopped replying.
sentences.tr: Bahanelerinden bıktı ve cevap yazmayı bıraktı.
sentences.de: Sie hatte seine Ausreden satt und hat einfach nicht mehr geantwortet.

meaning.en: to become more angry, excited or tense about something than it deserves
meaning.tr: bir konuda gereğinden fazla sinirlenmek, heyecanlanmak ya da gerilmek
meaning.de: sich über etwas mehr aufregen oder hineinsteigern, als es verdient

literal.en: work up = to build something up by working at it
literal.tr: work up = (bir şeyi) işleyerek yükseltmek, kabartmak

usage.en: get/be worked up (about/over sth) → the person's state. work yourself up (into a state) → doing it to yourself. Bare "work sb up" is rare; the natural form is: get sb (all) worked up.
usage.tr: get/be worked up (about/over sth) → kişinin hâli. work yourself up (into a state) → insanın kendi kendini doldurması. "work sb up" tek başına nadirdir; doğal olan: get sb (all) worked up.

collocations.en: all worked up · worked up over nothing
collocations.tr: all worked up · worked up over nothing

sentences.en: Don't [get so worked up] about it — it's just one bad grade.
sentences.tr: Bu kadar kafana takma, alt tarafı bir kötü not.
sentences.de: Reg dich nicht so auf – es ist nur eine schlechte Note.

sentences.en: He [gets all worked up] whenever politics comes up at dinner.
sentences.tr: Yemekte ne zaman siyaset açılsa hemen köpürüyor.
sentences.de: Er regt sich jedes Mal auf, wenn beim Essen Politik zur Sprache kommt.

meaning.en: to annoy someone (usually by something repeated)
meaning.tr: (tekrar eden bir şeyle) birini sinir etmek
meaning.de: jemanden nerven (meist durch etwas, das sich wiederholt)

equivalent.de: jemandem auf die Nerven gehen, jemandem auf den Keks gehen

usage.en: Subject = the annoying thing/person. Very common in the present continuous: "is getting on my nerves". Always plural: nerves.
usage.tr: Özne = rahatsız eden şey/kişi. Şimdiki sürekli zamanla çok yaygın: "is getting on my nerves". Hep çoğul: nerves.

collocations.en: really get on my nerves · start to get on sb's nerves
collocations.tr: really get on my nerves · start to get on sb's nerves

sentences.en: That clicking sound is really [getting on my nerves].
sentences.tr: Şu tıkırtı fena sinirime dokunuyor.
sentences.de: Dieses Klicken geht mir echt auf die Nerven.

sentences.en: I love my roommate, but he [gets on my nerves] sometimes.
sentences.tr: Ev arkadaşımı severim ama bazen sinirimi bozuyor.
sentences.de: Ich mag meinen Mitbewohner, aber manchmal geht er mir auf die Nerven.

meaning.en: to bother someone deeply; to say something that sticks and keeps hurting
meaning.tr: birini derinden rahatsız etmek; söylediği şey kafadan çıkmayacak şekilde batmak
meaning.de: jemanden tief treffen oder reizen; etwas sagen, das hängen bleibt

equivalent.de: jemandem unter die Haut gehen, jemanden treffen

usage.en: Subject = the irritant. "let sb get under your skin" is very common. Second (romantic) meaning: someone you can't stop thinking about.
usage.tr: Özne = rahatsız eden. "let sb get under your skin" kalıbı çok yaygın. İkinci (romantik) anlam: birinin aklından çıkmaması.

collocations.en: really get under my skin · don't let him get under your skin
collocations.tr: really get under my skin · don't let him get under your skin

sentences.en: Don't let him [get under your skin] — he's just trying to provoke you.
sentences.tr: Seni etkilemesine izin verme, sadece kışkırtmaya çalışıyor.
sentences.de: Lass dich von ihm nicht reizen – er will dich nur provozieren.

sentences.en: I don't know why, but her little comments really [get under my skin].
sentences.tr: Neden bilmiyorum ama onun o küçük imaları bana fena batıyor.
sentences.de: Ich weiß nicht, warum, aber ihre kleinen Bemerkungen treffen mich wirklich.

expressions.expr: drive someone crazy / nuts / up the wall

equivalent.de: jemanden wahnsinnig machen, jemanden auf die Palme bringen

literal.en: to "drive" someone to madness; to make them climb the wall

variety.en: AmE + BrE ("drive sb mad" is also very common in BrE)
variety.tr: AmE + BrE (BrE'de "drive sb mad" da çok yaygın)

usage.en: sth/sb drives me crazy. "It drives me crazy when + clause". Don't confuse with: be crazy about = to love (positive).
usage.tr: sth/sb drives me crazy. "It drives me crazy when + cümle". Karıştırma: be crazy about = bayılmak (olumlu).

sentences.en: It [drives me crazy] when people chew with their mouth open.
sentences.tr: İnsanların ağzı açık yemek yemesi beni deli ediyor.
sentences.de: Es macht mich wahnsinnig, wenn Leute mit offenem Mund kauen.

sentences.en: This printer is [driving me up the wall].
sentences.tr: Bu yazıcı beni çileden çıkarıyor.
sentences.de: Dieser Drucker bringt mich auf die Palme.

meaning.en: to no longer be able to stand something that keeps happening
meaning.tr: tekrar eden bir şeye artık katlanamamak
meaning.de: etwas, das immer wieder passiert, nicht mehr ertragen können

equivalent.de: etwas leid sein, es gründlich satthaben

literal.en: to be ill (and tired) from something

usage.en: be/get sick of + noun/V-ing. Intensified: sick and tired of, sick to death of.
usage.tr: be/get sick of + isim/V-ing. Güçlendirme: sick and tired of, sick to death of.

collocations.en: sick of hearing about it · sick of it · sick of this place
collocations.tr: sick of hearing about it · sick of it · sick of this place

sentences.en: I'm [sick of] having the same argument every weekend.
sentences.tr: Her hafta sonu aynı kavgayı etmekten bıktım.
sentences.de: Ich bin es leid, jedes Wochenende denselben Streit zu haben.

sentences.en: Honestly, I'm [sick and tired of] being the only one who cleans up.
sentences.tr: Açıkçası ortalığı tek toplayanın ben olmasından bıktım usandım.
sentences.de: Ehrlich, ich habe es so satt, die Einzige zu sein, die aufräumt.

meaning.en: (1) snap at sb: to speak to someone sharply and suddenly (2) "I snapped": patience suddenly running out
meaning.tr: (1) snap at sb: birine aniden sert çıkışmak (2) "I snapped": sabrın bir anda taşması
meaning.de: (1) jemanden plötzlich scharf anfahren (2) „I snapped“: die Geduld reißt plötzlich

equivalent.de: jemanden anfahren, anschnauzen; jemandem reißt der Geduldsfaden

literal.en: to break with a sharp crack

usage.en: snap at sb (preposition required). Intransitive: "I just snapped." A short, sudden reaction; blow up is longer and louder.
usage.tr: snap at sb (edat şart). Geçişsiz: "I just snapped." Kısa ve ani bir tepkidir; blow up daha uzun ve gürültülüdür.

collocations.en: snap at sb · something snapped · finally snapped
collocations.tr: snap at sb · something snapped · finally snapped

sentences.en: Sorry I [snapped at] you — I haven't slept properly in days.
sentences.tr: Seni tersledim, kusura bakma, günlerdir doğru dürüst uyumadım.
sentences.de: Tut mir leid, dass ich dich angefahren habe – ich habe seit Tagen nicht richtig geschlafen.

sentences.en: He kept pushing and pushing, and eventually I just [snapped].
sentences.tr: Üstüme geldi de geldi, sonunda ipler koptu.
sentences.de: Er hat immer weiter gebohrt, und irgendwann ist mir der Kragen geplatzt.

meaning.en: to lose control completely (usually anger; sometimes crying or laughing)
meaning.tr: kontrolünü tamamen kaybetmek (çoğunlukla öfke; bazen ağlama ya da gülme krizi)
meaning.de: völlig die Kontrolle verlieren (meist vor Wut; manchmal beim Weinen oder Lachen)

usage.en: "it" is fixed; what is lost is never named. lose it (with sb). Synonyms: flip out (AmE), go ballistic, go mad (BrE).
usage.tr: "it" sabittir, neyin kaybedildiği söylenmez. lose it (with sb). Eşanlamlısı: flip out (AmE), go ballistic, go mad (BrE).

collocations.en: completely/totally lose it · nearly lost it
collocations.tr: completely/totally lose it · nearly lost it

sentences.en: When he lied to my face a second time, I completely [lost it].
sentences.tr: Yüzüme karşı ikinci kez yalan söyleyince tamamen koptum.
sentences.de: Als er mir zum zweiten Mal ins Gesicht gelogen hat, bin ich völlig ausgerastet.

sentences.en: I nearly [lost it] when she called my thesis "cute".
sentences.tr: Tezime "şirin" deyince az kalsın çıldıracaktım.
sentences.de: Ich wäre fast ausgerastet, als sie meine Abschlussarbeit „süß“ nannte.

meaning.en: to annoy someone, make them angry

equivalent.de: jemanden aufregen, jemanden auf die Palme bringen

variety.en: AmE. In BrE "tick sb off" = to tell someone off (a different meaning!)
variety.tr: AmE. BrE'de "tick sb off" = birini azarlamak (farklı anlam!)

usage.en: tick sb off (separable) · be ticked off (at sb / about sth)
usage.tr: tick sb off (ayrılabilir) · be ticked off (at sb / about sth)

collocations.en: really ticks me off · ticked off about
collocations.tr: really ticks me off · ticked off about

sentences.en: It really [ticks me off] when he leaves his dishes in the sink.
sentences.tr: Bulaşıklarını lavaboda bırakması beni çok sinir ediyor.
sentences.de: Es regt mich echt auf, wenn er sein Geschirr in der Spüle stehen lässt.

sentences.en: She's pretty [ticked off] about the schedule change.
sentences.tr: Program değişikliğine bayağı bozuldu.
sentences.de: Sie ist ziemlich sauer wegen der Planänderung.

meaning.en: (1) to annoy someone on purpose, to tease (2) be wound up: to be tense, like a tightened spring
meaning.tr: (1) birini bilerek kızdırmak, takılmak (2) be wound up: gergin, kurulmuş gibi olmak
meaning.de: (1) jemanden absichtlich ärgern, aufziehen (2) be wound up: angespannt sein wie eine aufgezogene Feder

equivalent.tr: kızdırmak, damarına basmak, gaza getirmek; gergin olmak
equivalent.de: jemanden aufziehen, provozieren; aufgedreht, angespannt sein

literal.en: /waɪnd/ — to wind (the spring of a clock or toy)

variety.en: BrE (rare in AmE in this sense; AmE "wind up doing" = to end up doing something)
variety.tr: BrE (AmE'de bu anlam nadir; AmE'de "wind up doing" = sonunda kendini bir şey yaparken bulmak)

usage.en: wind sb up (separable) · be/get wound up (about sth) · a wind-up (noun: a tease, a joke)
usage.tr: wind sb up (ayrılabilir) · be/get wound up (about sth) · a wind-up (isim: işletme, şaka)

collocations.en: Are you winding me up? · really wound up
collocations.tr: Are you winding me up? · really wound up

sentences.en: Ignore him, he's just [winding you up].
sentences.tr: Aldırma, sadece seni kızdırmaya çalışıyor.
sentences.de: Ignorier ihn, er will dich nur aufziehen.

sentences.en: I was so [wound up] after the meeting that I couldn't sleep.
sentences.tr: Toplantıdan sonra o kadar gergindim ki uyuyamadım.
sentences.de: Nach dem Meeting war ich so aufgedreht, dass ich nicht schlafen konnte.

variety.en: In AmE "mad" = angry. In BrE "mad" mostly means "crazy"; for angry, BrE prefers angry with / cross with / annoyed with (but "mad at" is understood).
variety.tr: AmE'de "mad" = kızgın. BrE'de "mad" çoğunlukla "deli"; kızgın için angry with / cross with / annoyed with tercih edilir (ama "mad at" anlaşılır).

usage.en: be/get mad at sb (person) · mad about sth (topic) · make sb mad
usage.tr: be/get mad at sb (kişi) · mad about sth (konu) · make sb mad

collocations.en: mad at me · so mad · Don't be mad.
collocations.tr: mad at me · so mad · Don't be mad.

sentences.en: Are you [mad at] me? You've been quiet all day.
sentences.tr: Bana kızgın mısın? Bütün gün sessizsin.
sentences.de: Bist du sauer auf mich? Du bist schon den ganzen Tag so still.

sentences.en: She's still [mad about] what you said at the party.
sentences.tr: Partide söylediğin şeye hâlâ kızgın.
sentences.de: Sie ist immer noch sauer wegen dem, was du auf der Party gesagt hast.

expressions.expr: have had enough / have had it (with)

meaning.en: to have run out of patience; to refuse to put up with any more
meaning.tr: sabrı tükenmiş olmak, artık daha fazlasına katlanmayacak olmak
meaning.de: keine Geduld mehr haben; nichts mehr hinnehmen wollen

equivalent.tr: canına tak etmek, yetti artık demek
equivalent.de: genug haben, es reicht jemandem, die Schnauze voll haben

usage.en: Always present perfect: I've had enough (of sth) · I've had it (with sb/sth). "I've had it" can also mean "I'm exhausted, I'm finished".
usage.tr: Hep Present Perfect: I've had enough (of sth) · I've had it (with sb/sth). "I've had it" ayrıca "bittim, tükendim" anlamına da gelebilir.

collocations.en: I've had enough of this · had it up to here with
collocations.tr: I've had enough of this · had it up to here with

sentences.en: I've [had enough of] his attitude.
sentences.tr: Onun tavırlarından bıktım artık.
sentences.de: Ich habe genug von seinem Verhalten.

sentences.en: I've [had it with] this laptop — it crashed three times today.
sentences.tr: Bu laptop canıma tak etti, bugün üç kez çöktü.
sentences.de: Mir reicht es mit diesem Laptop – er ist heute dreimal abgestürzt.
